spans.s: मेशिका मेशिका in काल-म्˚, q. v.

मेशी मेशी, f., Ved. epithet of water in a
particular formula, (also read मेषी.)

मेष मेष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मिष्; accord-
ing to some fr. rt. 1. मिष्), a ram, wether, sheep,
(in Ved. applied also to a fleece or anything woollen);
the sign of the zodiac Aries, or the first arc of 30°
in a circle; a kind of drug; a species of plant [cf.
मेष-कुसुम, मेष-पुष्पा]; N. of a demon
said to possess children; (आ), f. a kind of carda-
moms; (ई), f. an ewe; Nardostachys Jatamansi;
Dalbergia Ougeinensis; [cf. काल-म्˚.]
—मेष-
कम्बल, अस्, m. a sheep's fleece or woollen dress
serving for an outer garment, a woollen rug or
blanket.
—मेष-कुसुम, अस्, m. Cassia Tora; [cf.
मेषाक्षि-कुसुम.]
—मेष-पाल or मेष-पा-
लक, अस्, m. a shepherd.
—मेष-पुष्पा, f. a
species of plant.
—मेष-मांस, अम्, n. the flesh
of sheep, mutton.
—मेष-यूथ, अम्, n. a flock
of sheep.
—मेष-लोचन, अस्, m. Cassia Tora.
—मेष-वल्ली, f. Odina Pinnata.
—मेष-वाहिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, riding on a ram; (इनी), f., N. of one of
the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, (also read मेघ-
वाहिनी.)
—मेष-विषाणिका, f. = मेष-शृङ्गी,
q. v.
—मेष-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. a species of tree
(enumerated among the द्रुमाणां राजानः); a
species of poisonous plant; (ई), f. Odina Pinnata.
—मेष-हृत्, त्, m., N. of a son of Garuḍa, (also
read मेघ-हृत्.)
—मेषाक्षि-कुसुम (˚ष-
अक्˚), अस्, m. Cassia Tora.
—मेषाण्ड (˚ष-अण्˚),
अस्, m. ‘having ram's testicles,’ an epithet of Indra.
—मेषान्त्री (˚ष-अन्˚), f. a species of plant (=
अजान्त्री, छगलान्त्री).
—मेषालु (˚ष-आलु), उस्,
m. a species of plant (= वर्वरा).
—मेषाह्वय
(˚ष-आह्˚), अस्, m. Cassia Tora.

मेषक, अस्, m. a species of vegetable, = जीव-
शाक; (इका), f. an ewe; [cf. काल-मेषिका.]

मेषाय, Nom. A. मेषायते, &c., to act like a
goat.
मेषायित, अस्, आ, अम्, acting like a ram or goat.

मेषूरण मेषूरण, अम्, n. (a word bor-
rowed fr. the Gr. μεσουράνημα), epithet of the
tenth astrological house.
